name: Potatoes Baked In The Half Shell
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: grated cheese or finely chopped ham
ingredients.originalText: grated cheese or finely chopped ham

instructions.text: Remove from oven and cut slice from top of each
Mash and add 2 tablespoons butter, 3 tablespoons hot milk, salt and pepper to taste
Add whites of 2 eggs well beaten
Refill skins and brown in a hot oven
Grated cheese may be sprinkled over the top or finely chopped ham may be added to the potato mixture

source.originalInstructions:
1. Bake 6 medium-sized potatoes
2. Remove from oven and cut slice from top of each
3. Scoop out inside
4. Mash and add 2 tablespoons butter, 3 tablespoons hot milk, salt and pepper to taste
5. Add whites of 2 eggs well beaten
6. Refill skins and brown in a hot oven
7. Grated cheese may be sprinkled over the top or finely chopped ham may be added to the potato mixture
